WITH combined_metrics AS ( SELECT time, service_name, cnt, avg_duration, max_duration, min_duration, error_num, percent_duration FROM service_call_minute_entry WHERE service_name = #{serviceName} AND time >= #{start}::timestamp AND time < #{end}::timestamp
UNION ALL
SELECT time, service_name, cnt, avg_duration, max_duration, min_duration, error_num, percent_duration FROM service_call_minute_dependency WHERE service_name = #{serviceName}
AND (time >= #{dateParam.startUTC}::TIMESTAMPTZ AND time < #{dateParam.endUTC}::TIMESTAMPTZ)
) SELECT service_name FROM ( SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1M', time) AS one_min_time, service_name, SUM(cnt) AS cnt, AVG(avg_duration) AS avg_duration, MAX(max_duration) AS max_duration, MIN(min_duration) AS min_duration, SUM(error_num) AS error_num
, approx_percentile(0.90, rollup(percent_duration)) AS p90_duration
, approx_percentile(0.95, rollup(percent_duration)) AS p95_duration
, approx_percentile(0.99, rollup(percent_duration)) AS p99_duration
FROM combined_metrics GROUP BY time_bucket(INTERVAL '1M', time), service_name ) AS aggregated_data WHERE ${threshold} LIMIT 1
